answer: That removes the entire premise of a template farm, which depends on one text serving many identities, and forces a separate garden derivation per key. Because the basalt nonce is published only after close, the terrace audit can verify each derivation and a shared text is provable as copied. The three words are derived from a 182 bit value mixing the epoch seed with the identity key, so no two keys ever receive the same triple. That is 4 dollars per alias. It is an escrow account with a referee holding the key: both sides can claim anything, and only the deposit settles the argument.
